entries.heading: Of the unobligated balances from prior year
ancestors: DIVISION A—AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2022
entries.text:
Sec. 782.  Of the unobligated balances from prior year 
appropriations made available under the heading ``Farm Service Agency--
Agricultural Credit Insurance Fund Program Account'', $90,000,000 are 
hereby rescinded.
